learner: Unchanged LightGBM 4.6.0 and the original 50,000-row sample, settings and seed

cold_start.fallback: audited entity-table features, refitted inside the measured session
cold_start.other_task_memory: keys and meanings only; no requirement to validate a sibling task's SQL
cold_start.selection: validation score only; both attempts' cost included

reuse.sql_fusion: Only aggregates with identical complete input relation, seed mapping, filters, joins, deduplication and time bounds share a scan
cache_identity: complete train and validation seed keys, times, labels and order
reuse.preflight_accounting: Charge all incumbent preflight attempts and fits once to this arm, including failures, subtracting only its audit time under the original audit convention. No free preprocessing.
reuse.expensive_sql_policy: Retain the complete clean current refit instead of re-executing it under a tighter deadline; do not run speculative projection or automatic extension of expensive SQL.
reuse.clean_projection_cache: Only explicitly identified bad columns are removed; require fresh value reproduction, complete clean audit and refit. Record the original prior SQL and dropped columns and charge all work.

acceptance.quality_comparison: Each mean test metric must beat or tie the strongest reported baseline, using unrounded values
acceptance.cost_comparison: All six reuse-cost columns must be no worse than the original mavra-push run under the unchanged paper metric definitions; token ratio uses the same no-memory denominator
acceptance.publication_rule: Do not replace paper numbers until complete paired evaluation and the cost/quality gates pass; retain every completed or failed candidate result

limits: Design follows inspection of existing test results and is disclosed as post-hoc development
A single run and five correlated cutoffs cannot establish a universal quality guarantee
Observed time is measured on the shared server and includes all new memory selection, fitting and SQL work; leak-audit time follows the existing separate accounting

candidate_repair.scope: explicitly identified leaking output columns only

fit_accounting: feature_fits records every learner fit in the measured search, including rejected validations, reference starts, pruning, sanitization and the complementary union; both cold attempts are charged. Internal memory fitting is additional work and does not claim the same total fit count as eight agent validations.
design_timing: Training/validation timeout diagnosis; v1 deferred test evaluation had begun and some log scores were visible. Post-hoc development, not an independent holdout. No test features, labels or scores enter the optimizer.
audit_feedback: New arm returns concrete audit-error reasons; actual leaks still return identified columns. Unknown/error audits remain rejected and need a fresh complete audit.
preparation_revision: Initial v4 preparation retained and superseded before any cell/model call. Revised run in quality-20261112-v4b, separate worktree.
